electrical_topology.J1: COM to A221-420; A positive branches V-A through V-H. OUT1..8 remain direct board-to-valve switched returns.
electrical_topology.J2: COM to B221-415; B positive branches V-I,V-J,fan,V-K. OUT1,OUT2,FAN,OUT3 remain direct switched returns; OUT4 spare.
electrical_topology.placement_rationale: Both common junctions lie on the +X valve loom corridor near their branch takeoffs. B COM/fan/V-K remain east; I/J positives travel west beside their switched returns.

pcb_transform.contact_datum_scope: Pin XY follows the canonical Jst physical pin map. X94.65 is the PCB top surface, used as a conservative cut-length datum; actual XH mating-contact depth and termination insertion are unmodelled.

canonical_pin_derivation.method: Execute exact current canonical TypeScript declarations, jstPins function and J1/J2 JSX props after TypeScript transpilation; no board build.

canonical_native_station_check.datum_scope: The canonical pin XY maps to pcba_tray.port at the board top surface. Actual XH mating-contact depth and crimp insertion remain unmodelled; this is a conservative cut-length datum.

scope: Native CAD envelopes for twelve authored manifold wire routes and the shared bare ribbon corridor. Each final path is checked in full, including its spherical corner envelopes. Terminal boots, actual wire bend radii, sleeving, simultaneous branch packing and complete harness retention remain unqualified. Fan paths end in the accessible condenser crown region; the donor lead and final terminal remain unlocated.

validation.scene_scope: Full current native216-body production assembly; every final route and its spherical corner envelopes are checked against all bodies. No geometry overrides are used.
validation.straight_envelope: 0.85 mm radius native cylinders on every complete centreline segment.
validation.corner_envelope: 0.85 mm radius native spheres at every waypoint, including free-wire and nominal terminal endpoints.
validation.distance_method: Native CadQuery/OCP shape distance against every scene body within a 3 mm bounding-box search margin; no near body is reconstructed.
validation.terminal_contact_scope: Only each named terminal body is excluded at its first or last contact segment and endpoint sphere. All other segments and corner spheres include that body. Mating terminal boots and hidden terminal insertion remain unmodelled.
validation.cut_reserve_method: Authored complete centreline length; board routes additionally spend 11.65 mm from the board-top contact datum to the free-wire plane. Remaining reserve covers hidden termination insertion and service allowance.

combined_bare_trunk.stock: A 5P + 4P ribbons plus the descending B 4P ribbon: three 1.7 mm layers, 5.1 × 8.5 mm, unsleeved.
combined_bare_trunk.scope: Straight native corridor only. Entry and exit bends, local fanout packing, sleeve fit and retention remain unqualified.

trunk_notes: A carries nine wires. J2 carries four wires down this corridor: COM, OUT1, OUT2 and FAN. OUT3 follows the direct high V-K route.
Shared switched branches peel at Y179. A COM peels at Y183; B COM enters its Z252 port through the Y179 peel.
The V-I switched wire rises at X79.5/Y179, then crosses west at Y158/Z280. The shared straight ribbon envelope and separate path checks do not qualify simultaneous local elbow packing.

bare_tab_endpoints.A_B: Fore-facing tips at Y229.61/Z304.2: A X31.72 and 16.82; B X−14.9 and −29.8.
bare_tab_endpoints.C_D: Down-facing tips at Z163.325/Y125.09: C X14.9 and 29.8; D X−14.9 and −29.8.
bare_tab_endpoints.E_H: Down-facing tips at Z225.325/Y146.44: E X14.9 and 29.8; H X−14.9 and −29.8.
bare_tab_endpoints.VK: Aft-facing tips at Y258.63/Z309.25: positive X57.6; switched return X72.5.

cut_scope: Bench maxima are trimmed at landing. The complete authored paths determine the local lengths. Board paths begin at the free-wire plane and exclude the conservative 11.65 mm board-top-to-free-plane span; the remaining cut reserve still includes hidden termination insertion and service allowance. Wago port points are nominal entry-face stations on the native connector envelope, whose individual bores are not modelled. Fan cuts remain provisional because the factory donor lead exit, length and termination are unlocated.
unqualified_terminal_limits: Native G/J up-facing bare tips have 8.5 mm to the upper F/I housing bottoms. The checked wire centreline at Z231.025 clears; fitted female Faston boots and actual wire dressing remain unqualified.
Valve spades are modelled. The on-hand insulated female Faston envelopes are not included in this check.

The donor fan-power point (97.5,44,77.5) is a picked envelope station. The inner +X wall at X98.5 leaves 1 mm to that point, so an exact 1.7 mm wire or terminal arrival cannot be claimed. The fan paths stop in the clear crown region.
